mapper.select: select user_uuid from post_comment where id = #{commentId} and status = 1 limit 1

select pc.id, pc.post_id as postId, pc.user_uuid as userUuid, u.nickname as nickname, pc.content, pc.created_at as createdAt from post_comment pc left join user u on pc.user_uuid = u.uuid where pc.post_id = #{postId} and pc.status = 1 order by pc.created_at asc
